answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 36524 Country: India Title: Wearing tie with suit is haram or halal in Islam? Question: Wearing tie with suit is haram or halal in Islam? Answer ID: 36524 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 210/114/H=1433) Some people of fatwa have the view that tie is the religious sign of Christians, as per them it is haram. And as per those who have a different view it is makrooh. However, it is better to avoid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
